Mash launches quiz competition on Liberation War history
2018-03-03T14:52:10+06:00 | Star Online Report
https://www.thedailystar.net/sports/mashrafe-bin-mortaza-launches-quiz-competition-on-bangladesh-liberation-war-history-of-1971-1542886

An online quiz competition, based on the history of Liberation War in Bangladesh, has been launched in a bid to spread the spirit of the War of Liberation among school students across the country.

Bangladesh ODI captain Mashrafe Bin Mortaza inaugurated the competition title ‘quiz71’ at a ceremony at Liberation War Museum in Dhaka’s Agargaon area today.

Students from class VI to XII will take part in the contest after completing their registration in online on www.quiz71.com.

The registration will start on March 7 while the competition will continue from March 25 to 31.

Project London 1971, an NGO in Bangladesh, arranged the competition in assistance with the Ministry of Liberation War and six other organisations.
